reading.title: Letter regarding Holly Place PILOT Agreement

candidates.quote: The Project involves the new construction of a seventy two (72) unit affordable rental housing community for seniors earning sixty percent (60%) or below of the Area Median Income ("AMI"), located at 4500 Saint Barnabas Road, Temple Hills, Maryland 20748.

The Project involves the new construction of a seventy two (72) unit affordable rental housing community for seniors earning sixty percent (60%) or below of the Area Median Income ("AMI"), located at 4500 Saint Barnabas Road, Temple Hills, Maryland 20748.
candidates.wording: sixty percent (60%) or below of the Area Median Income

candidates.quote: The PILOT will require a mandatory annual payment in an amount of no less than approximately fifty two thousand, seven hundred eighteen dollars or seven hundred thirty two dollars per unit ($52,718 or $732 per unit) for the first year.
candidates.wording: PILOT will require a mandatory annual payment

candidates.quote: Thereafter, the required payment for these affordable units will increase by two percent (2%) for each subsequent tax year.
The PILOT agreement will remain in effect for forty (40) years, including the extended affordability period.
